# Coastline Digital
> Forward-deployed AI firm that specializes in enterprise application solutions. Engineers embed with the client's team, learn the actual workflow, and ship working software in production rather than handing over slide decks.

## Services
- Enterprise application solutions: custom internal tools, workflow automation, and integrations with existing systems. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/enterprise-applications/
- AI and machine learning solutions: applied AI (LLM-powered assistants and agents, document and data pipelines), predictive and machine learning models, and evaluation and deployment. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/ai-machine-learning/
- Websites and apps: web and mobile app builds, marketing sites, and Google Business Profile cleanup. https://coastlinedigital.net/services/websites-apps/

## How we work
- Embed: join the client's team and learn the workflow first-hand.
- Build: short cycles inside the client's environment, with evaluations for AI work.
- Ship: deploy to production, support real use, hand over code and documentation.
